help: Bot name tables for True 1.65 Mode (one style per race). Edit while the server runs: it reloads this file within a minute.
Lists are words separated by spaces. In 'mids' a dash (-) means 'nothing'.
A name is: start + mid + end (template A); races with long=true also get start + mid + bridge + end (template B).
Variants (optional per race): double (Thor-Thorr), c2k (Cael-Kael), i2y (Kaelin-Kaelyn), ix (Vex-Vexix), az, son, mac, o.
Weights set how often each kind is picked. Changing a list restarts that list's counter; names already used are skipped.
Every name also passes invalidnames.txt, the quality filter and 'botOnlyBlocked' (famous fictional names, bots only).
Names already worn by players, bots or one-word NPCs are never given out.
